title: Carnitas
subtitle: Slow-cooked pork for tacos, burritos, or bowls

ingredients.text: 3 to 4 lb pork shoulder, cut into large chunks

steps.text: Season the pork with salt, pepper, cumin, and oregano.
Place the pork in a Dutch oven or slow cooker with the onion, garlic, orange juice, orange peel, lime juice, chicken broth, and bay leaves.
Cook low and slow until the pork is very tender, about 3 to 4 hours on the stovetop or 8 hours on low in a slow cooker.
Remove the pork and shred it with forks.
Heat oil in a skillet and crisp the shredded pork in batches until browned at the edges.
Serve with tortillas and your preferred toppings.

notes: For extra flavor, save some of the cooking liquid and spoon it over the finished pork.
Classic toppings include onion, cilantro, salsa, and lime.
The crisping step is not optional if you want carnitas and not just polite shredded pork.
